# Native capture: Flow batch action fault with filtered update

A fresh 30-day scratch org was created from a campaign Dev Hub and the synthetic project deployed. The project contains Flow and action API 62 sources; the ceiling files are exact API 67 variants. API 67 Flow/action was deployed first and test classes at 62 and 67 run, then both were redeployed at API 62 and the 62 class rerun. The synthetic action records its input size and throws; its fault connector leads to a filtered update of a separate synthetic target. Tests cover two matching source records, two matching plus one nonmatching start-filter control, 200 matching records, and an overlength rejection. Size lists are copied before later cases. Observations are JSON assertion payloads with identifiers, email addresses and URLs scrubbed. The scratch org was deleted and ScratchOrgInfo status verified as Deleted.
